meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.coverage: Foreign exchange reserves every week since April 2001, valued in rupees and in SDRs
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 574, week-ending Fridays plus 31 March and a few holiday-shifted dates. ₹ crore and SDR million: the same holdings as external-reserves-weekly, valued at other prices.
